summary: Master contract analytics and obligation tracking with practical tools, templates, and reporting methods. Join TrainingCred and improve control in 5 days.
lede: Contract analytics and obligation tracking turn contract clauses, dates, and performance commitments into actions teams can assign and monitor. This course is for professionals managing active contracts, supplier agreements, or commercial commitments who need to track ownership, deadlines, and evidence. It covers clause classification, obligation registers, SLA and renewal monitoring, exception escalation, and performance reporting, with exercises in scorecards and workflow automation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work with active contracts, supplier agreements, or commercial commitments and need clearer control over what has been promised, by whom, and by when.
prerequisites: You should bring familiarity with contracts, procurement, supplier management, legal operations, or commercial administration. A laptop and spreadsheet software are recommended, along with sample contract extracts or a current tracking template if your organization can provide them.
